title: Amazon Web Services (AWS)
description: AWS reference covering accounts, regions, IAM, networking, compute, storage, databases, serverless, messaging, observability, security, reliability, cost, infrastructure as code, and incident readiness.

subtopics.title: Organizations, Accounts, Regions & AZs
subtopics.description: Use multiple accounts as strong isolation boundaries, choose regions for users/compliance/services, and spread production across Availability Zones.

codeBlocks.code:
Organization
├─ Security / Log Archive
├─ Shared Services
├─ Production account(s)
└─ Non-production account(s)

subtopics.title: IAM Roles, Policies & Federation
subtopics.description: Prefer short-lived federated sessions and workload roles. Evaluate identity policy, resource policy, boundaries, SCPs, and explicit denies together.

callouts.title: Explicit Deny Wins
callouts.text: Least privilege requires both narrow allows and organization guardrails. Never embed long-lived access keys in code, images, or repositories.

subtopics.title: VPC, Subnets, Routing & Endpoints
subtopics.description: Routes decide reachability; security groups are stateful resource firewalls; NACLs are stateless subnet filters. Private subnets still need explicit egress/service paths.

codeBlocks.code:
Internet -> ALB (public subnets, multi-AZ)
             -> ECS/EC2/Lambda ENIs (private subnets)
             -> RDS/ElastiCache (isolated subnets)
Private service traffic -> VPC endpoints where supported

subtopics.title: EC2, ECS, EKS & Lambda
subtopics.description: Select compute by control needs, workload shape, team maturity, startup/latency, portability, and operational burden.

subtopics.title: S3, EBS & EFS
subtopics.description: S3 is regional object storage; EBS is block storage attached within an AZ; EFS is managed shared POSIX file storage.

codeBlocks.code:
aws s3 cp artifact.zip s3://example-artifacts/releases/artifact.zip
aws s3api head-object --bucket example-artifacts --key releases/artifact.zip

callouts.title: S3 Is Not a Filesystem
callouts.text: Design around whole-object operations, keys, versioning, lifecycle, checksums, multipart upload, and request semantics.

subtopics.title: RDS/Aurora, DynamoDB, ElastiCache, SQS & SNS
subtopics.description: Choose relational databases for constraints/joins, DynamoDB for known key access at scale, ElastiCache for disposable acceleration, SQS for durable queues, and SNS/EventBridge for fan-out/routing.

callouts.title: Queue Consumers Must Be Idempotent
callouts.text: At-least-once delivery means duplicates are normal. Define visibility timeouts, retries, poison-message handling, and DLQ redrive.

subtopics.title: CloudWatch, CloudTrail, Backups & Resilience
subtopics.description: Centralize metrics/logs/traces, retain audit trails, encrypt data, test restore, design multi-AZ first, and choose multi-region only from explicit recovery objectives.

codeBlocks.code:
SLI/SLO -> alarms -> runbook -> owner
RPO/RTO -> backup frequency -> restore test -> failover drill
CloudTrail + config/change events -> central immutable archive

subtopics.title: Landing Zones, Keys & Threat Detection
subtopics.description: Use Organizations and Control Tower-style landing-zone controls for account provisioning, centralized audit, guardrails, identity, and network baselines. Manage encryption keys and secrets separately from application configuration.

codeBlocks.code:
Prevent: SCPs, permission boundaries, VPC/service policies, WAF
Protect: KMS, Secrets Manager, ACM, backup vault controls
Detect: CloudTrail, Config, GuardDuty, Security Hub, Access Analyzer
Respond: EventBridge/automation, isolated roles, tested runbooks

callouts.title: SCPs Do Not Grant Permissions
callouts.text: Service control policies set the maximum available permissions for member accounts. Identity and resource policies must still grant access, and management-account behavior requires separate review.

subtopics.title: Infrastructure as Code, Cost & Production Checklist
subtopics.description: Use reviewed IaC and progressive delivery; tag ownership; budget and anomaly-alert costs; remove idle resources; model quotas and regional dependencies.

callouts.title: Production Checklist
callouts.text: Separate accounts, federate access, enforce least privilege, use multi-AZ, encrypt, centralize logs, test backups, set budgets/quotas, scan IaC, pin artifacts by digest, and rehearse incidents.
